query: Lithium ion battery cells South Korea United States import duties

statements.text: Yes, EV battery cells and packs from China face Section 301 tariffs of 25% on top of the base 3.4% duty. This has accelerated battery production shifts to South Korea, Japan, and domestic US facilities.
And US companies now have to pay a 15% tax on those batteries, where previously they didn't.
South Korea and Japan, as major battery manufacturers, now sit in the forced-labor tariff's 10% tier
Korean manufacturers like LG and Samsung SDI an even wider competitive advantage over Chinese alternatives
South Korean batteries now face only the 10% forced-labor tariff on top of any base duty — a marked improvement from their former IEEPA reciprocal rate
South Korea and Japan are now the clear winners for battery sourcing, with the 10% forced-labor tariff offering a dramatically lower tariff burden than China's 37.5% combined rate
